environment: Actual React UI with controlled same-origin API fixtures; no provider transport, no real funds or payment; external Playwright fallback because Browser plugin unavailable.
limitations: Fixtures establish UI behavior only, not hosted provider/authentication/cap enforcement.
Viewport emulation is not physical-device or unfamiliar-user acceptance.

checks: collapsed Eidos performs no AI account/quote/provider request
unavailable account/provider preview remains honestly gated with manual project intact
legacy aiReady cannot enable Playground; dedicated flag, account and ledger gates remain separate
server-derived included/purchased balances, usage, reservation, monthly cap and exact reset are visible
quote shows exact scope, estimate, maximum and discard charging disclosure before explicit confirmation
proposed/current visual comparison uses the shared renderer read-only and does not mutate the actual project
all Finish entry points are disabled for an unapplied proposal and restored for the actual current draft
usable generation charges actual usage even when discarded and leaves manual project unchanged
Apply preserves project identity, adds no provider call and is one exact shared Undo/Redo edit
a manual edit invalidates an unsubmitted quote and cancellation adds zero provider executions
delayed result cannot overwrite newer manual work; actual generated usage remains visible
selection and Brand changes retain the receipt but block stale confirmation
unknown/pending status keeps the action ID and reservation; status checks never retry generation
reload/Continue restores pending action status without resubmission or applying it to another revision
technical waiver is explicit while provider uncertainty remains an Eidos obligation
Stop waiting latches unknown submission despite a late response, disables repeat confirmation and checks only the existing action
account changes clear the previous owner receipt and proposal without replacing local manual work
explicit cap lowering preserves existing commitments and never triggers funding, generation or automatic cap increases
a malformed monetary receipt cannot create a confirmation control or provider execution
manual draft and source identity survive all fixture paths with no runtime errors or horizontal overflow
